turns.text: Sure! Vulgar words often appear in online spaces during heated debates or when people are expressing strong emotions. For example, "heck" or "damn" might be used to emphasize frustration or anger. In more casual settings or among friends, you might hear terms like "dude" or "man" to interject humor or informality into a conversation. On the other hand, more explicit language can come up in very informal or private chats, but it’s less common in public forums like tweets. Context really matters—same words can mean different things depending on who's saying them and why.
